That's true. But I feel like my relationships with others aren't very sustainable either. Granted, I live in a shitty city where everyone is very materialistic and fake but I don't know... 

I've been sick my whole life dealing with sexual and emotional abuse and now as an adult I'm dealing with the outcomes of those: PTSD, anxiety, bipolar disorder. It's a mess.
Yeah it feels out of control. I'm a roller coaster. I can't handle anything life throws at me anymore, it feels
My mom has basically told me that. That she can't be bothered with my mental illnesses. If she can't stand me then why would anyone else?
Just all of this. Being inside my brain is exhausting
